notes.title: EASTER EGG HUNT!!
notes.content:
Greetings friendly folks!

Spring has arrived! We know this season's lovely weather is great for hanging out with your beloved one, but storming the dungeon doesn't make it easy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/474c8ad75ddc7e61243c030cea65cca900cd39cc.gif[/img]

We've decided to make your journey through the dungeon smoother, so you can focus on the princess or prince you're rescuing! Scattered across the dungeon there are 15 easter eggs, that contain experience and tokens to level up your knight easier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/6c31350735cca363750fa4c9abfbaeb2fbd12c55.png[/img]

Most of these eggs are in the Castle area, so they will be accessible for new players too! And remember, if you like it you can consider leaving a positive review on Steam, and adding your suggestions or feedback for the next updates!
Thanks a lot! ːsteamhappyː


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/ca6f7627819e5f6aa470cc82c0d7e4f26c06883a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Tower Princess Update 1.04 - New Feature!!!
notes.content:
[h1]New Community Feature[/h1]
Greetings fellow knights!

Our community has asked to keep the princess you've chosen to rescue once you defeat together the Evil Dragon, so...

We've heard you! Before, once you've beaten the game with a princess, you could only find her crown at her regular spot at the Entry Hall, as she has already been rescued. Now she's back with the crown over her head, so you can storm the dungeon together, AGAIN!

[h1]Update Highlights[/h1]

[list]
[*] Once you've beaten the game with a princess or prince they no longer disappear
[*] Fixed small issue with Sunder special ability
[*] Fixed Kobold bards endlessly buffing themselves
[*] Minor lighting and collision fixes

[/list]
+ Some bug fixes
+ Minor improvements


If you like it, you can consider leaving a positive review on Steam, adding your suggestions or feedback for next updates, thanks a lot!

notes.title: Nominate Tower Princess for Best Game You Suck At Award
notes.content:
Hi Knights,

The Steam Awards Nomination has started, and we’d like to ask you to vote for Tower Princess in the Best Game You Suck At category!

Despite its cartoonish and cute visuals, Tower Princess is tough, just as an old school action platforming adventure should be, so we believe it fits perfectly.

Thanks in advance, and have a great week!

notes.title: Meet Human Princess! Release in ONE week!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello friendly folks![/h3]

[h3]We want to remind you that Tower Princess is coming out just in one week! On September 8 for PC, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch!

Please, check out our awesome release trailer![/h3]

[previewyoutube=7GlCrRdRH-g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]XBOX One ver. will come out just in a few weeks, we'll announce it later.[/h3]

[h3]We also want to introduce to you [b]Human Princess[/b] and tell you about her backstory, character and quirks![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/b24d635132438d67e3fedf2c188a206a1e714640.png[/img]

[h3]Bio: [/h3]

The Human Princess has all the things you may expect from a perfect princess, as such fine beauty, refined manners, an evil stepmother, or a dark omen upon birth. 

The tale tells that the court wizard (because everyone knows there’s a wizard in any respected court) foresaw that once the Human Princess reached adulthood a relentless Evil Dragon would appear, burning down the royal castle. Only to lock her in the highest among the highest towers. And of course, only True Love could save her from that fate.

Everyone also knows that a wizard can’t be wrong. So the King and Queen only found a possible way to prevent such an omen... Helping her to find a charming prince before it’s too late Building themselves the highest tower, and locking there the princess. You can’t imprison someone who is already imprisoned. Logical, isn’t it?

In that way, the Human Princess grew up with all the comfort and luxury anyone would have ever dreamt of, but was forever locked on a tower. All she had to do was to find her true love, but as her lifestyle didn’t make her too sociable, it was such a hard task.

In the end, and to everyone’s surprise, the Evil Dragon ended up appearing and burning down the castle as expected. Though the Dragon has taken her to his own castle, the Human Princess's life hasn’t changed so much.

And there she is, still waiting to be rescued. If it was hard to rescue her due to her bad temper, now there’s also a big red dragon in the way. Now any proper suitor must be ready for both challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/c2758b856075a90513f3f694cab8fae30ccfc3c2.gif[/img]

[h3]Favorite food:[/h3]

Which kind of princess wouldn’t like sweets? 

Imagine the most refined chefs of the land, cooking the finest meals you can conceive just for you. Even more, imagine the most exquisite tea accompanied by the sweetest sweets and cookies. It’s good, and even better if you can have as much as you want, right?

Now imagine how may a bunch of kobolds cook. Aside from that food isn’t enough for princess standards, those pants-less lizards don’t know how to make candies or have tea. And that seems a reason more than enough to want to be rescued as soon as possible.


[h3]Date of Birth:[/h3]

October 16th, just 19 years before the Dragon showed up!

Being born under a cursed moon that only exists every few years doesn’t seem a good idea, but one doesn’t decide its own birthday. 

That defined her life of confinement. But no one imagined that the Dragon came looking for lots of princesses, and the Human Princess was only one of them. So maybe, and only maybe, it was impossible to prevent the dragon's arrival. We’ll never know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/cc29d60846a042f7d9117990de2e27e522c567a4.png[/img]

[h3]Likes:[/h3]

- To sing, and even dance, when she’s doing her tasks. But only when no one is near. The only ones that have heard her are the little birdies that were in the tower, so she isn’t sure if she actually sings well. 
- Have we already mentioned sweets? 
- Being a princess, of course. Yes, the life of confinement can be quite boring, but despite that, she loved the attention she received there and all the beautiful and shining things she had in her tower.
- And of course, she loves the idea of being rescued by a knight in shining armour. But not any knight, only the one that proves to be worthy of rescuing her, and of treating her as she really deserves. After all, she’s still a wealthy and highly refined princess.

[h3]Dislikes:[/h3]

- Dragons, or anything similar, for obvious reasons.
- Humdrum, vulgar, and poorly mannered suitors. Or what are the same, suitors who do not live up to her expectations.
- Poisoned fruit, sewing with fluorescent spinning wheels, or crystal shoes. Why should a princess like those things? The crystal shoes still have a pass (they are like walking barefoot, but without soiling your feet!), but they rub her feet, and that’s not nice!
- But above all, what she hates the most is waiting for that knight in shining armour. It’s taking a lifetime of boredom.

notes.title: COMMUNITY FEEDBACK!
notes.content:
Hey friendly folks!

Before anything else, thank you so much to all those knights who entered the dungeon at the Knight's Trial! It's been really heartwarming to receive so much support from the community, but even most importantly, we've received lots of feedback too!

So we've heard that feedback, and implemented as much as we could in the game!

MAJOR CHANGES
ːsteamthisː We've added difficulty levels! Easy mode will be perfect for those who just want to enjoy a casual experience in the dungeon, and know the princesses! Medium is thought for those that want a challenging experience but haven't played before, or that don't have experience with platformers or roguelites. And Hard mode is intended for experienced players that look for a true challenge, as the game was originally meant to be!

ːsteamthisː Right now the gameplay of the knights should feel much more swift, with faster transitions between animations and an increased responsivity from the player input!

ːsteamthisː Keybinding! If you didn't find the default set of controls comfortable, now you can make your own from the Options menu!

ːsteamthisː You can change between princesses at the Entry Hall. You didn't feel ready to rescue a certain princess? Don't worry, ask out another one to enter the dungeon!


MINOR CHANGES
- Now jumps interrupt basic attacks!
- Increased the length of some princesses' power
- Nerfed the Mimic Crab's damage
- Given a different colour for each princess crown in the HUD
- Given more space between princess and knight
- Fixed some issues when using the Kobold power during the tutorial
- Added options for motion blur and FPS settings
- Each boss specific mechanic changes according to the difficulty level!
- And many details more!


If you already played Tower Princess alpha or beta, and felt it needed any of these things, we're waiting for your feedback to keep improving the game! It's really great to be able to push Tower Princess even further thanks to the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/1bf577ff651d65f8af647cf70395d8405ad957f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Upgrade System + Hidden Treasures!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings friendly folks![/b]

Beating the dungeon and rescuing the princess (or prince) of your dreams might be a difficult feat, especially if it's your first time at the Dragon's Castle.  But fear not,  fellow knights,  as we have [b]some valuable tips to learn how to improve your skills and find some decent loot![/b]

[h1]The Upgrade System[/h1]
The upgrade system lets you improve your stats and unlock some skills depending on your gameplay.
 
Initially it will be minimal, but it will expand more once you free the Kobold Shopkeeper and get the Bureaucrat Leader to come to the Entry Hall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/ac4028dc08e7198a529889187bd29cac9d02ef5a.png[/img]

There are four main elements to upgrade:
[list]
[*] [b] Armour:[/b] Represents the health of the incoming knights. It levels up using healing items! This one is managed by the Kobold Shopkeeper even if he's jailed.
[*]   [b]Sword:[/b] It measures the damage and special abilities when using a knight with a broad sword. You can level this stat by defeating enemies with the sword! Managed by the Kobold Shopkeeper at his weapon workshop.
[*]   [b]Musket:[/b] Mostly the same as the previous one, but with a musket!
[*]   [b]Map:[/b] Improving the map lets you see the location of certain rooms before exploring them. Exploring new rooms raises this stat. This is the only one managed by the Bureaucrat Leader.
[/list] 
To buy these upgrades you will need two things!
[list]
[*] [b] Tokens:[/b] You earn these by achieving certain milestones in the dungeon, such as rescuing princesses, opening chests or defeating bosses. [b]These are the points you actually spend to buy upgrades. [/b]
[*]  [b]Skill Level!:[/b] Each one of those elements has its own level, which increases separately. [b]You can't spend more tokens than the level you have in the skill.[/b] Remember that some upgrades also require a minimum level to be bought!
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/4c1d2324e4daefda263d0c07c3157f1f13782bf8.png[/img]
Getting these upgrades can increase the damage or the health of your knights, but it can also unlock two special abilities for each weapon!
[list]
[*]  [b]Dash Attack:[/b] Stabs your enemies with your sword from distance, getting you directly into battle! It can be upgraded to even stun the enemies hit!
[*]  [b]Spin Attack:[/b] That old technique of swinging your sword all around like a maniac. A highly offensive stance with low mobility, though that can be improved by upgrading it!
[*]  [b]Explosive Shot:[/b] Quite a self-explicative name, isn't it? If upgraded it can even reload your musket each time you use it!
[*]  [b]Shotgun Shot:[/b] Shoots your musket with a powerful cone attack, kicking you back, quickly pushing distance between you and the danger!
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/85292759ff2ea10bf8cc493a8796c540d7379c3c.png[/img]

[h1]Hidden Treasures![/h1]

You can be a skilful knight, but without the proper loot, you will still be vulnerable against the dungeon's toughest challenges!
[b]You can find useful trinkets  (and even gifts for your beloved one) hidden among the dungeon's destructible furniture, or in possession of some enemies.[/b] But if you want to increase your chances of finding something really useful, you'll have to look for the huge treasure rooms in each area!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/3957f797a88b67c086e181b019d5619d20954d18.png[/img]

But the dungeon is too big to only have two treasures! If you have a keen eye, [b]you may find some illusory walls that hide more chests that may have something useful![/b] These chests won't have the same chances to have a high-tier item as one of the Treasure Rooms, but any help is welcome when it comes to surviving in the dungeon!

You may find some of these spots a bit erratic or hard to find,  but there's someone that can help you with this! It is said that [b]there's a certain princess with a keen eye for riches and shiny things that can point out these spots[/b], only to the worthy suitors she can trust!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/ac7b0a75d91720e0f449a0c34440fc008abe6fa8.gif[/img]

We hope you've found this useful! Being a knight is hard, but it's just a matter of practice to find all the secrets hidden out there!

If there’s anything you would like to know about Tower Princess feel free to tell us!
Remember to add Tower Princess to your wishlist so know the release date once we announce it!

See you soon, and as always, thanks for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/1031c63433081e7c2ee3cf10013d62f43b421f5b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dive into Tower Princesses' lore!
notes.content:
[h3]WELCOME TO THE DRAGON’S CASTLE, HUMBLE KNIGHT![/h3]

[h2]Greetings friendly folks![/h2]

These last weeks we’ve seen many potential knights preparing themselves to enter the dungeon, and asking about what kind of challenges and inhabitants lure deep within it. So we’ve thought it would be an excellent idea to make a series of updates, sharing some info about the princesses and the guardians that keep them captive there, as well as about some game mechanics that will help our knights to survive (and even beat) the dungeon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/413bf86528642cb198de2656349a7bad65e01493.jpg[/img]

[h3]Let’s start with the most basic thing… what the hell has happened here?[/h3]

Tower Princess takes place in a Far Far Away Land, where lots of different fairy tale creatures lived. This place was divided into an infinity of kingdoms, each one with its own folk and culture. However, due to all the differences that separated them, and the desire of ruling over all the land, there was an Endless War that nobody seemed able to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/69988ca495be7ebd080bf6443387a6fc03c755e7.png[/img]

One day, like any other, a mysterious castle appeared somewhere in this Far Far Away Land. From this ominous castle aroused a mighty fire-breathing dragon, who kidnapped the princes and princesses of every known kingdom, and ate any suitor that tried to stop it.

For the first time in a long time, all the rulers put aside their differences, signing a truce. For the royal lineage was magical, and it was of the utmost importance to keep it.

Every kingdom desired to break the truce once its royal heir was rescued, so none of them had the courage to send their armies to the Dragon's Castle. Instead, they announced everywhere a call for wandering knights. They offered a place in the royalty to anyone who rescues their heir!

Any knight with theoric knowledge about rescuing princesses knew that it wasn’t healthy to face a dragon that roasted heroes as a hobby. But the promise of greatness, and maybe true love, attracted lots of humdrum wandering knights eager to try their luck.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662282/4bdaf2f23b2d46566532667377bf8bdc4e704c31.png[/img]

Shortly after there was an endless queue of knights and knightesses at the gates of the Dragon’s Domains, where they patiently waited their turn to enter. And here’s where you take place, as one of those random knights who await to enter the dungeon, to rescue a royal heir, defeat the Evil Dragon, and become a hero in its own right!

[h3]If there’s anything you would like to know about Tower Princess feel free to tell us!

notes.title: Play New Demos by HypeTrain Digital – Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
Hi!

We’re delighted to take part in the Steam Game Festival (June 16 - June 22), which is already live now! Throughout the event we've brought demos for each of the 8 games we are currently working on. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/7abeae814099c7e99930eac874f252bae2418cb1.jpg[/img]

All of them are in different genres, settings and styles. You will surely find something that piques your interest! All the content available for Steam Summer Festival is free, some demos are long, some allow infinite play. Here is a little sneak peek of every title available.

[h1]Voidtrain[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/24e19a0b140c0b6ba83248df68f6e3487ea01ea7.jpg[/img]

Voidtrain is a first-person action/survival game where you become a crew member of an interdimensional express. Build your own train, upgrade it, craft weapons and travel across different mysterious worlds full of outlandish creatures, Nazis and other dangers. 

https://youtu.be/o0bIODWSX5Y

Voidtrain’s demo features a base loop of the game, where you’ll be able to travel between biomes on your train, gather resources to upgrade it and stop by interdimensional train depots filled with Nazis ought to be defeated.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159690/Voidtrain/

[h1]Tunche[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/808ffccf6882a1b363b56fb5974520d31e81bbbe.jpg[/img]

Tunche is a charming, hand-drawn beat'em up hack and slash game with roguelike elements, co-op and a pinch of shaman witchcraft. Visit the amazonian jungle alone or together with your friends, choose one of the 5 unique characters and hack through hordes of enemies!

And if you like A Hat in Time, we got a big surprise for you — Hat Kid will be the 5th Playable Character in the game. Moreover, you’ll be able to test her in the demo! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/887450/Tunche/

[h1]Linked Mask[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/836f39a47efe14ee46476b2b34cd0b1589117e91.jpg[/img]

Do you miss the golden era of Game Boy? Linked Mask is a 2D platformer that will make you reminiscent of the good old days, where a player has to overcome six towers, collect six masks containing elemental powers and ultimately conquer the Castle of the Primals. And there’s a chillingly cool soundtrack that will make your head bop as you traverse the deadly Towers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111590/Linked_Mask/

[h1]Jack Move[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/f8610a50c9a9492fa4b446b492de33263cedb4ad.gif[/img]

Plunge into a VHS-era cyberpunk world of Jack Move, an RPG featuring japanese style turn based battles and gorgeous Hi-Bit pixel art. Take on the role of Noa, a vigilante hacker who is thrust into a world of murder, kidnapping and dark research after her father goes missing.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0yOLVvhsJFw

There’s a brand new demo of Jack Move available that features a new slums area, a new dungeon and a whole bunch of new enemies for you to tangle with. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099640/Jack_Move/

[h1]Black Book[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/acc2d0ccff5b5a3512dca0a38d0825549dedb276.gif[/img]

Black Book is a dark RPG Adventure based on Slavic mythology and featuring card-based combat. You will take on the role of Vasilisa, a young sorceress on a quest to revive her beloved one. In order to do so, she has to uncover all the 7 seals of Black Book — a demonic artefact, said to be powerful enough to grant any wish. 

The demo features an essential part of the story — the First Day of Vasilisa becoming a witch. You’ll be able to test test the core game mechanics, battle regular demons and even test your strength in a fight against a boss.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

[h1]There Is No Light[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/9543af773b7ab1760c993449121e62b139a6e6c0.jpg[/img]

There Is No Light is a pixel-art action adventure in a dark post-apocalyptic setting, which tells a story of a protagonist fighting against a fallen underground civilization and its appalling religious rituals. 

In this demo you’ll be able to explore a small part of the game world. Visit a village, the existence of which remained unknown for a long time. Find out how people live in the underground world ruled by the Church of the Great Hand. Find your own playstyle by combining 3 available weapon types, so that eventually you can fight a giant boss Behemoth that gets in your way to freedom.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132980/There_Is_No_Light/

[h1]Tower Princess[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/403d20cb011202cd3f6da5a5f5c44bfa5e63aca8.jpg[/img]

Tower Princess is a 3D roguelike action platformer where you'll have to beat a dungeon, defeat a dragon, rescue a princess/prince and manage a perfect date with them! There’s a wide variety of royalty members you can hit on — you’ll be able to find someone you like even if you’re not into humans. 

The demo is a linear and brief sample of a run in one of the Castle's areas. It shows the visuals and the core gameplay of Tower Princess, but it's focused on the princess aid in combat, as without her help, you wouldn't stand a chance against the Evil Dragon. Are you ready to test yourself as a knight in shining armour?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138650/Tower_Princess/

[h1]SuchArt![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/58eec9f3b1771872af7c94beb1b8d603f48ce8ec.gif[/img]

SuchArt is a painting sim game featuring you being such an amazing artist. Really you rock, your latest DNA test is very positive about it. Now please paint, sell and expose your art from your new studio aboard the Space City. And don’t forget — the only limit is the size of your brush (or a flamethrower).

SuchArt demo features a separate room (a virtual studio instead of a real one you’ll get in the full game) with a limited amount of tools and an introductory part of the story. However, you’ll be able to test the core game mechanics and take a couple of commissions from virtual clients, which is already fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt/

notes.title: New Tower Princess demo available during the Steam Games Festival!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re AweKteaM, a small indie studio based in Spain. There are just 3 of us: Mario and Marcos (artists), plus Oscar (programmer). We’re currently working on our first title as a studio – Tower Princess.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/IzM7P31I9a5r5atfCQ/giphy.gif[/img]

Tower Princess is a roguelike action platformer where you'll have to do your best to rescue a princess or prince and conquer their heart at the same time you survive the endless dangers of the Dragon's Castle, from its own minions to corridors full of death traps. 

We’ve prepared an updated demo of Tower Princess, especially for the Steam Games Festival. This demo is a linear and brief sample of a run in one of the Castle's areas. It shows the visuals and the core gameplay of Tower Princess, but it's focused on the princess aid in combat, as without her help, you wouldn't stand a chance against the Evil Dragon. Are you ready to test yourself as a knight in shining armor?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138650/Tower_Princess/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/887450/Tunche/
